_readme: Ground truth for the enrich eval. `expect` is what the funding digest's two
gates SHOULD do with this company: 'keep' = US-headquartered AND in a
KEEP_CATEGORIES sector; 'drop' = fails one of those. `why` records which,
so a failure report says what was expected and on what basis.
These labels are hand-written and are the weakest link in the eval - they are
one person's understanding of where a company is based. The harness does not
trust them blindly: it corroborates the researched HQ against the company's
OWN website, so a bad label tends to surface as a disagreement between the
label and the corroboration rather than as a silent pass.
Entries with expect:'' are deliberate hard cases (genuinely dual-HQ or
ambiguous companies). They are observed, not graded - they exist to show how
the researcher behaves when there is no clean answer.
